name: Power Platform environment
short_description: A container in Microsoft Power Platform where business data, apps, chatbots and flows are stored and managed together. Each environment belongs to a Microsoft Entra tenant, is bound to a region and can hold at most one Dataverse database.

evidence.quote: A power platform environment is a space where your business data, your apps, your chatbots
